instruction: Set Chrome to block third-party cookies for better privacy and to avoid cross-site tracking.

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to enable third-party cookie blocking in Chrome. The evaluator reads the profile.block_third_party_cookies setting from Chrome's Preferences file and checks if it is set to true. This privacy feature prevents websites from setting cookies that can track users across multiple sites.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to block third-party cookies
Getter extracts the correct Chrome preference setting (profile.block_third_party_cookies) from the Preferences file
Metric correctly compares the extracted state against the expected value using proper parameter handling
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure settings persistence is verified
Complete coverage - single requirement task is fully verified
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts boolean setting, metric compares boolean values
Minor concern: Chrome preference path 'profile.block_third_party_cookies' may vary across Chrome versions, though this is the standard legacy path
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding fallback checks for alternative Chrome cookie preference paths (e.g., profile.cookie_controls_mode or profile.default_content_setting_values.cookies) to handle different Chrome versions
The getter could log which preference path was successfully read for debugging purposes
